title: Propagate: jmap-filenode-server Inner-state nested HashMap restructure
description:
## Sibling propagation of canonical bd:JMAP-grs0.1

Depends on bd:JMAP-grs0.1 (mail-server canonical fix) landing first. Mirror the canonical fix byte-for-byte modulo TYPE_NAME constants.

## Fix shape

See bd:JMAP-grs0 epic body and bd:JMAP-grs0.1 for the canonical pattern. The Inner struct becomes:

```rust
struct Inner {
    objects: HashMap<&'static str, HashMap<String, HashMap<Id, Value>>>,
    states: HashMap<&'static str, HashMap<String, u64>>,
    change_log: HashMap<&'static str, HashMap<String, Vec<ChangeEntry>>>,
}
```

Read-path helpers take `&str` and don't allocate; write-path helpers preserve auto-register-via-or_default.

NOTE: filenode-server may use a different storage shape (uses .with_account(&str) builder rather than register_account / new_with_accounts). Audit first; if storage shape differs, document the divergence rather than force-restructuring.

## Acceptance

- Mirror the canonical fix
- All read-path helpers take `&str` and don't allocate
- cargo test -p jmap-filenode-server green
- cargo clippy -p jmap-filenode-server -- -D warnings green
